Helpy / Ways neighbors help

Tutoring from the neighbors, for free

A kid stuck on fractions. A student a month out from an English exam. An adult who'd finally like to get Excel. On Helpy, neighbors offer to help with what they know, as volunteers, with no price list.

Download on theApp StoreGet it onGoogle Play

For example

  • Maths and English for primary and middle school
  • Getting ready for a test or a final exam
  • Help with an essay or a CV
  • Excel, slides and other software

How it works

  1. Download HelpyIt's free on iPhone and Android. Sign in with Google, or with Apple on iPhone.
  2. Post or browseSay what you need, or scroll to see who nearby is offering help.
  3. Sort it out in chatAgree on where and when, meet up, then rate each other.

Good to know

  • For a child's lesson, a parent stays home, or meet somewhere public like a library.
  • Say the grade, the subject and the topic so the right people reach out.
  • A short first session shows whether it clicks.

Questions

Are the lessons paid?

No. On Helpy neighbors help as volunteers. For a paid private tutor, look elsewhere.

I'd like to help, but I'm not a teacher.

You don't need a certificate. If you're good at something, post an offer with the subject and age group, and people who need it will reach out.

Does it cost anything?

No. The app is free, and help between neighbors is never paid.

Who can see where I live?

Posts show a rough area and a distance, never an address. Your exact location is only shared with the neighbor you approve.

Is it safe?

Before you reach out to a neighbor, you verify your phone number. Profiles carry ratings and reviews, and you can report or block anyone in one tap. We don't run background checks, so whether to meet is always your call.
